_readme: Closed-world set of Sentry test suites the sentry-suites CI gate runs and asserts (issue #1779, ADR 0059). scripts/sentry-suite-gate.mjs reconciles this against findSentrySuites() by exact set equality in both directions, then for each non-exempt suite spawns `env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u NODE_PATH node <nodeArgs> <suite>` and asserts exit 0, fail == 0, pass >= floor, and pass == the per-case lines it emitted. reporter: count-line = the homegrown `ok <name>` / `<n> passed` harness (per-case marker `^ok `); node-test = node:test run under the spec reporter (per-case marker `^✔ `, summary `ℹ pass`/`ℹ fail`); exit-only = no per-case counts, exempt from the gate and re-verified by route. floor uses >= semantics: adding tests never breaks the gate; a deletion reds it until the floor is lowered here, which is a security-relevant review signal. Floors were measured against origin/main and must be re-measured when a suite changes.
